extracted.name: Tasty Ground Turkey Tacos
extracted.description: This tasty ground turkey taco recipe, made with tomato sauce, taco seasoning, and green chiles, can be topped with lettuce, Cheddar, or other toppings.
ingredient_lines: 1 (4 ounce) can diced green chile peppers
1 cup shredded lettuce, or to taste
0.5 cup Cheddar cheese, or to taste
0.5 cup diced tomatoes, or to taste
0.25 cup chopped green onion, or to taste
0.25 cup chopped cilantro, or to taste
2 tablespoons sliced olives, or to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add turkey; cook and stir until browned, about 5 minutes. Add tomato sauce, water, green chiles, onion, taco seasoning, and garlic; simmer, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 30 minutes.
Serve turkey mixture in tortillas. Top with lettuce, Cheddar cheese, tomatoes, green onion, cilantro, and sliced olives.
